defs.def: a large musical instrument played by pressing the black and white keys on the keyboard. The sound is produced by small hammers hitting the metal strings inside the piano. 钢琴adverbadj.

ex.s: Most page turners are piano students or up-and-coming concert pianists, although Ms Raspopova has once asked her husband to help her out on stage.
ex.t: 大多数翻谱员是钢琴学生或崭露头角的音乐会钢琴家，尽管拉斯波波娃女士曾经让她丈夫在台上帮忙。

ex.s: When he had to stop 4______(swim) due to health problems, he decided 5_______(learn) how to play the piano with his toes.
ex.t: 当他因健康问题不得不停止______（游泳）时，他决定______（学习）用脚趾弹钢琴。

ex.s: It has a piano museum with over 200 pianos.
ex.t: 它有一个拥有200多架钢琴的钢琴博物馆。

ex.s: John, you can play the piano.
I never thought I was very talented at anything to do with music, but my parents wanted me to learn to play the piano at the age of six.
ex.t: 我从来没想过自己在音乐方面有什么天赋，但我父母在我六岁时就想让我学弹钢琴。

ex.s: Experienced in reading her students’ minds, my piano teacher could tell after a couple of lessons that my heart was not in it.
ex.t: 我的钢琴老师很会洞察学生的心思，上了几节课后她就能看出我的心并不在上面。
